title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis, hourly temperature and humidity)
summary: Open-Meteo archive endpoint returning hourly reanalysis values (temperature_2m in °C, relative_humidity_2m in %) for any latitude/longitude on a grid, not station observations. Probes at northern-Italy coordinates (45.46, 9.19) returned 72 hourly rows each for 2004-03-10 to 2004-03-12 and for 2024-01-01 to 2024-01-03, so both UC1 windows respond; the grid point returned was 45.45/9.17 at 138 m elevation. The client city is not named in any source, so the coordinates used here are a probe value only, not a confirmed site.

fields.name: time
fields.description: Hourly timestamp, ISO8601, in the requested timezone (UTC in the register default)

schema.notes: Field list taken from the API response shape (hourly_units). Response also carries latitude, longitude, elevation and utc_offset_seconds as metadata. No docs fetched in this profile; docs_url is https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/historical-weather-api (not read).

spatial.code_system: decimal latitude/longitude; grid points snapped to nearest reanalysis cell
spatial.notes: Queried by coordinates. Tested at 45.46, 9.19 (returned grid 45.448154, 9.169279). Register default is Lisbon 38.72, -9.14, which is not the client location. Client site coordinates are unknown and must be recorded as an assumption.
